## Findings beyond the module

1. HARNESS GAP — tests/unit/_load.py cannot load extensionless modules. It calls
   importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path) with no explicit loader, which
   returns None for an extensionless file (tools/runner), so `_load.load("tools/runner")`
   raises ImportError("cannot load"). The README claims _load.py "loads hyphenated and
   extensionless modules" — that is currently false for the extensionless half. This row
   worked around it (SourceFileLoader in test_runner.py) rather than editing the shared
   _load.py, to avoid colliding with the T788/T789/T790 lane. Owner for the real fix: T789
   (test-gate wiring) or a follow-up harness row.
2. Near-duplicate: `_argv_model` (line ~1604) and `_model_from_argv` (line ~464) are the
   same --model parse; consolidate into one, then canonicalize it once (T751).
3. _declared_tenant_reservation_bytes returns 0 on ps failure/returncode!=0 — a false
   "no tenant", not "don't know". Part of the T785 S08 fix (with the 36MB race).
